question: Simplify the following. 72 ÷ 8 × 4 +40 - 35 ÷ 5 + 15
solution:
**Given:**

72 ÷ 8 × 4 + 40 - 35 ÷ 5 + 15

Concept used:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/83ad200c05af7ff0a96c689e1309a38eee4e23c73e3e9636ad108a7806b6c852.png] 

**Calculation:**

72 ÷ 8 × 4 + 40 - 35 ÷ 5 + 15

⇒ 9 × 4 + 40 - 7 + 15

⇒ 36 + 40 - 7 + 15

⇒ 76 - 7 + 15

⇒ 69 + 15

⇒ 84

**∴ The correct answer is option (2).**
